completedSteps.name: Re-run Leiden with hierarchical levels

completedSteps.notes: Added materializeCommunityNodes() to CommunityDetection.js. Created 1,036 Community nodes across 4 levels (L0: 694, L1: 175, L2: 86, L3: 81). Uniqueness constraint had pre-existing data conflict (non-fatal).

completedSteps.name: Create MEMBER_OF relationships
completedSteps.notes: Created 21,559 MEMBER_OF relationships linking code nodes to L0 Community nodes.

completedSteps.name: Enrich Community metadata
completedSteps.notes: Enriched 694 L0 Community nodes with languages, keyMembers, memberCount. Fixed Cypher syntax error (WITH clause variable scoping). L1+ nodes not enriched yet (only have MEMBER_OF from L0).

completedSteps.name: Compute INTERACTS_WITH edges
completedSteps.notes: Created 1,640 INTERACTS_WITH edges (L0: 751, L1: 447, L2: 231, L3: 211) with minStrength=3. Some edges collapsed during final count (1,297 unique).

completedSteps.name: Create PARENT_OF hierarchy
completedSteps.notes: Created 978 PARENT_OF relationships forming the community hierarchy tree across 4 levels.

completedSteps.name: Re-generate hierarchical summaries
completedSteps.notes: Added summarizeHierarchical() + generateParentSummary() to CommunitySummarizer.js. Generated 828 hierarchical summaries across 4 levels (L0: 486, L1: 175, L2: 86, L3: 81). Stored in both Neo4j Community nodes and ChromaDB (replaced collection). 55s total.

completedSteps.name: Wire into GraphGuidedRetrieval
completedSteps.notes: Updated retrieveGlobal() in GraphGuidedRetrieval.js: level-aware search (prefers higher levels for global context), drill-down via PARENT_OF to show sub-communities, INTERACTS_WITH edges in output.

completedSteps.name: Update pipeline script
completedSteps.notes: Added --materialize flag to run_community_detection.js. Without flag: original flat pipeline. With flag: full 24E-5 hierarchical pipeline (project → Leiden → Community nodes → MEMBER_OF → PARENT_OF → INTERACTS_WITH → metadata → summaries).
